7.3.6 Diagnostic Data Management
In various situations, the
Diagnostic Server instance
facilitates reading or writ-
ing of particular diagnostic data. One needs to distinguish between internal and ex-
ternal diagnostic data. By definition, internal data is managed by the
Diagnostic
Server instance
itself, and external data is managed by external applications. In
the latter case, communication between
Diagnostic Server instance
and the
external application takes place via Service Interfaces. There are several Service In-
terfaces defined concerning diagnostic data.
The purpose of this chapter is to describe the supported use-cases for handling diag-
nostic data and the way how to configure each use-case within the DEXT.
Recall that a
DiagnosticDataIdentifier
is composed of
DiagnosticParame-
ters
each of which aggregates a single
DiagnosticDataElement
. In different use
cases, it is required to manage diagnostic data either on the level of
Diagnostic-
DataIdentifier
or on the fine granular level of
DiagnosticDataElements
.
